data.fullPrompt:
Transform this living_room into a contemporary space, working around the anchoring architecture.

cool slate color palette, sleek manufactured materials, sparse minimal atmosphere

New materials: Materials: matte concrete, brushed nickel, sleek upholstery.

Layer with: a potted plant, ceramic vessels, art books, chunky knit throw, jute rug. Minimum 8 decorative objects.

Ceiling: standard-8ft with 9ft. Natural light: brightest in the morning. 3 windows.

Apply the aesthetic from the reference image to the vacated zones only — not to the anchoring pieces. Reference direction: Photorealistic interior photograph of a living room. Gallery wall of mismatched art frames in bold colors. Two different-pattern sofas: one deep red velvet, one mustard yellow. Layered kilim and Persian rugs overlapping. Hanging macrame and trailing pothos plants. Moroccan-style lantern, brass floor lamp, neon sign. Visually dense, every surface has objects. Wide angle lens, eye level, warm layered lighting, architectural magazine editorial. Sharp focus..

Final constraint: the walls, floor, ceiling, windows, doors, and camera angle must appear identical to the input image. Only the furniture and decor in the vacated zones are to be redesigned.

Photorealistic interior photograph, The image is captured from a standing height (approximately 5-6 feet off the floor) at the threshold or entrance of the room, looking straight into the room. The camera is slightly angled towards the right, encompassing the bed, the white and blue rolling cart to the left, and the window on the left wall, providing a broad view of the room's main features., 24mm, f/8. No people, no text.
